jamie (support): FYI customer on ticket #4521 reports a prod crash after upgrading our Python SDK to 1.13.0 — TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'credentials'. They say it started after a deploy this morning. Link to logs: https://support.internal/t/4521 :worried:

alex (sdk): Can you paste the stack trace and their requirements / pip freeze? quick check: are they using the client class or the helper factory?

jamie (support): Stack trace (redacted) below and pip list they sent:
```
TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'credentials'
  File "/srv/app/main.py", line 54, in create_client
    client = RedwoodClient(api_key=..., credentials=creds)
  File "/venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/redwood/sdk/client.py", line 88, in __init__
    ...
```
Pip: redwood-sdk==1.13.0
python==3.10.9
requests==2.31.0

jamie (support): Repro steps they provided: pip install redwood-sdk==1.13.0, run service that instantiates RedwoodClient with credentials kwarg.

maria (eng): I think we changed the constructor arg name in 1.13 from `credentials` -> `auth` when we unified the auth surface for dedicated/private. We intended to keep a deprecation alias but it looks like we accidentally removed the alias. That would explain the TypeError.

alex (sdk): Ugh. Regression slipped in. Confirmed in changelog PR: we converted param name and relied on `**kwargs` forwarding in tests, but not in the public constructor.

alex (sdk): Short-term mitigation for customers: pin to 1.12.2 (latest 1.12 patch) until patch release. Command: `pip install "redwood-sdk<=1.12.2"`

maria (eng): I'll open a hotfix branch to reintroduce a compatibility alias that maps `credentials` -> `auth` and add a unit test. Will target a 1.13.1 patch.

jamie (support): I'll reply to the customer with the pin + repro steps and ETA for patch. Also asked them to confirm they can apply the temporary pin; will follow up. :thumbsup:

alex (sdk): For internal ops: mark this as a P1 for SDK and set a deploy hold on auto-rollouts for the next canary wave. deploy-bot, can you block 1.13.0 auto-promote?

deploy-bot: Auto-promotion for redwood-sdk v1.13.0 has been paused for canary and staging environments as requested. (Reason: compatibility regression - credentials param removed)

maria (eng): Patch PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/redwood-sdk/pull/789 — fixes alias + adds test + changelog note. Will run CI and aim for 1.13.1 release tonight.

alex (sdk): Once CI is green I'll cut the patch and coordinate with support to update the KB. KB note to add: "If your code passes `credentials=` to RedwoodClient, pin to <=1.12.2 or update to 1.13.1+ where param is `auth` (compat alias restored)."

jamie (support): Thanks — I'll update the customer and close loop once they confirm pin works or after we release 1.13.1.

maria (eng): postmortem item: add a pre-release compatibility smoke that instantiates the public client with both old and new kwarg names.

jamie (support): adding to ticket. Closing Slack thread for now, will reopen if customer sees other failures. :white_check_mark:
